entities.name: Beam measurement reporting
entities.description: Procedure for UE to include beam measurement information in a measurement report by selecting sorting quantities and including beam indexes/results based on configured parameters.

entities.name: Event-triggered report type
entities.description: Condition where reportType is set to eventTriggered, determining the sorting quantity selection logic.

entities.name: Periodical report type
entities.description: Condition where reportType is set to periodical, determining the sorting quantity selection logic.

entities.name: Sorting quantity
entities.description: The measurement quantity used to sort beams in decreasing order for reporting.

entities.name: RSRP
entities.description: Reference Signal Received Power, used as sorting quantity when available.

entities.name: RSRQ
entities.description: Reference Signal Received Quality, used as sorting quantity when available.

entities.name: SINR
entities.description: Signal to Interference plus Noise Ratio, used as sorting quantity when available.

entities.name: rsIndexResults
entities.description: Information element containing up to maxNrofRS-IndexesToReport SS/PBCH block indexes or CSI-RS indexes in order of decreasing sorting quantity.

entities.name: resultsSSB-Indexes
entities.description: Information element containing SS/PBCH block indexes and associated measurement results.

entities.name: resultsCSI-RS-Indexes
entities.description: Information element containing CSI-RS indexes and associated measurement results.

entities.name: absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation
entities.description: Absolute threshold for SS/PBCH block consolidation, included in VarMeasConfig for the associated measObject.

entities.name: absThreshCSI-RS-Consolidation
entities.description: Absolute threshold for CSI-RS consolidation, included in VarMeasConfig for the associated measObject.

entities.name: includeBeamMeasurements
entities.description: Condition that when set to true, includes beam measurement results for each SS/PBCH block or CSI-RS index.

relations.description: Beam measurement reporting procedure is guarded by event-triggered report type condition.
Beam measurement reporting procedure is guarded by periodical report type condition.
Event-triggered report type establishes sorting quantity selection from trigger quantity, RSRP, RSRQ, or SINR.
Periodical report type establishes sorting quantity selection based on configured single quantity or RSRP/RSRQ.
Beam measurement reporting procedure contains rsIndexResults information element.
rsIndexResults contains resultsSSB-Indexes for SS/PBCH block based measurements.
rsIndexResults contains resultsCSI-RS-Indexes for CSI-RS based measurements.
resultsSSB-Indexes inclusion is guarded by absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation threshold condition.
resultsCSI-RS-Indexes inclusion is guarded by absThreshCSI-RS-Consolidation threshold condition.
resultsSSB-Indexes inclusion of beam measurement results is guarded by includeBeamMeasurements condition.
resultsCSI-RS-Indexes inclusion of beam measurement results is guarded by includeBeamMeasurements condition.
